feeling: A machine that has found glass-hour's tune and will not stop running it faster.
intent: Glass-hour as an acid line, the short one, for a short: the tune is the loud notes of a fast low line that speeds up until it breaks. Nobody has heard it: it was checked by measurement only. It plays through a stand-in acid sound of the composer's until the machine's own is ready, so there are no slides between notes yet.
listen_for: Glass-hour's tune as the loud notes in the low line from 0:04; the kick at 0:11; and at 0:25 the fast run from the middle of glass-hour, with everything hitting.

parts.name: thin
parts.change: a low line of fast notes alone, over a tick and a tock
parts.feels: thin, wound up: a clock and a wire

parts.name: ice
parts.change: glass-hour's tune appears as the loud notes of the line

parts.name: hairline
parts.change: a kick on every beat, a low bass, the line with no gaps; then a climb

parts.name: spreads
parts.change: the tune jumps up to its own height, chords stab, the bass rolls

parts.name: breaks
parts.change: the fastest tempo; glass-hour's run of notes, everything loud

parts.name: after
parts.change: the clock alone, three low notes at a time
parts.feels: cold after: the machine still ticking
